Every time I went to get a treatment or consultation it was a new doctor, that asked me different questions. The last time I was there I thought I was getting dentures, but they made me have another consultation and told me the same information I already knew, but it was a new doctor so I paid twice for the same service. It is very annoying. Additionally, the last doctor that worked on my tooth did not care that the patient is in pain, continues until to the point where I cannot bear it and wants to give me a third anesthetic injection, which is too much, and tells me to breathe, at which point the room smelled noxious because it is near a toilet that has the sewage smell leaking by. I could not bare it and had to take a break from the pain. Otherwise, my previous fillings were done well.
I think it is expensive and they have a rotation of doctors and cannot communicate well in English. Ultimately would not recommend, dentists will usually try to make as much money as possible, and the system this clinic has is a perfect example. I only got a written record later on in treatment, which did not seem to help with the multiple consultations that cost 500 baht each. The dentist told me the same information as the orthodontist did, which was only a couple of weeks before. You go in expecting treatment, but get charged for another round of the same information, which was showing me a metal brace on Google images.
Apparently to get a temporary denture, which I waited three weeks for, you have to be charged a consultation, twice and you will not actually end up getting the denture. Try getting through to the receptionist.
